creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A card can wait on a board in a repo you haven't cloned. Kan could fetch just that board and read it, instead of making you clone the repo.

Starting sketch in `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, section "Deferred". Open: the fetch mechanism, when a copy refreshes, and making sure a fetched copy and a registered clone of the same board can never both be in use.
title: Design: fetched read-only copies of boards not on this machine
